dct_description_sm: See readme.txt files for file descriptions.

Data base contains original geophysical log and image log data in .LAS and .DLIS formats,  processed files in WellCAD (.WCL), extracted data in tabular form, and code and data used to make figures.   These data were collected in 2011 and 2013 by the University of Alberta as part of geothermal exploration of the Hunt Well immediately west of the city of Fort McMurray (56°45’N, 111°33’W).  We do not have permission to give out data provided to us by the original well owners during drilling of the well, and only extracted results are available.
dct_title_s: Geophysical Logging and Image Data from the Hunt Well, NE Alberta
